disclosures: contract 13 has no dedicated prerequisite-missing class; `data_window_invalid` is used as the closest registered card-local class, and its own definition covers 'instrument 缺失'. Unlike the earlier cards in this series the calendar windows here DO overlap (raw 2022-01-01..2026-09-16 vs the record's 2024-2026 sample), so the terminal is an instrument/market absence and is stated as such in both artifacts rather than dressed up as a window mismatch

the record registers a dual-venue TradFi construction (OCC-cleared IBIT listed options vs CME cash-settled futures, priced off BRRNY at 16:00 ET, margined on OCC/CME parameters) and its own Crypto-portability paragraph states the trade cannot be executed purely via crypto-native venues; neither reading is executable locally and both are registered, neither was shrunk to manufacture executability

the inherited USER_FIXED execution envelope (linear USD-M perp, 10x, 12-tranche geometric DCA ladder) is written for a perpetual book while this record's object is a wedge-threshold carry trade with an expiry settlement; the tension is recorded in `execution_invariants_disclosure` and not resolved by inventing a mapping

the card's required-data excerpt lists the record's seven Required-data bullets; the record's Execution assumptions, Evidence, Falsification plan (four items), Crypto portability, Limitations and Adoption boundary paragraphs are carried in full verbatim in the round-spec and expanded into the 30-row required-data matrix - nothing dropped

the raw is updated daily by the store's own updater: the card quotes klines to 2026-09-11 and funding to 2026-09-12T08:00Z while the measured values are daily bars to 2026-09-16 and funding to 2026-09-17T00:00Z (updater last_run 2026-09-17T02:15:05Z); both readings are recorded and neither is rewritten

the store's funding rows carry `truth_status`: the backfilled history is `modeled_funding` and only the tail is `official`; recorded because it would matter to any future funding-based accounting, though nothing was computed here

the host scan is not reproducible across measurement points: a scanned root is the repo this card writes to, so the totals drift (round-spec at authoring: 4145 files / 2821 token files; live re-check: 4613 files). The invariant is the hit structure - 6 data-shaped hits, all classified, 0 unclassified, no decisive requirement group carried by a series-shaped row - not the raw file count
